issues.what: Inside SplitCompare the photo's index card is cut off by the top edge of the panel. Only its bottom third shows: in f600 the panel top is at y≈112 at half scale and the card shows only y 115-150. This holds in the Hard-drive panel for the whole split (f484-~1130) and in the SSD panel until the push-in at ~f640. The 'struck card with taut threads' that the split is meant to contrast is mostly outside the frame.
issues.fix: Re-pose the split framing so the whole card sits at least 16 px (half scale) inside each panel: move it down about 60 half-px, or zoom to about 0.9. If archiveCam('split') in the kit causes this, fix it there, because the same framing is reused in S6, S7 and S9.

issues.what: For 'The drive cleans up later' the SSD panel shows only small amber embers flickering on the photo's 9 boxes, run by run (f673-697), plus a 40 px clock glyph from f667. There is no visible sweep band or drive actor. The caption also fades out at f667-673, so for about 30 f the drive's action is close to invisible at half scale. Motion stays below 1.5 from f670 to f767.
issues.fix: Drive a full-height amber sweep band across the SSD panel from f655, starting at the amber drive actor (lower-left), and clear each run as the band passes it with a brief ember flare. Keep the Hard-drive panel idle. Hold the caption until the sweep finishes.

issues.what: The race-tease scanners fall through the header and chip row just after the chips land. Pixel count shows the coral chip 'Probably, but not certainly.' (landed f888) losing about 55% of its pixels at f900-902, and 'Not yet.' partly covered at f894-900.
issues.fix: Start the scanner drops below the chip row (content y ≥ 230 at 1080p), or start them at f906 after the chips settle, so no must-read chip is crossed.

issues.what: The RecycleBin 'empty' state still shows a blank white photo card in its slot: before the delete (f0), after 'You empty the recycle bin' (f90-120) and at the S2 start (f1400). The emptied bin therefore never looks empty, and the flush at f73-90 reads as the passport swapping for a blank card.
issues.fix: Make the kit RecycleBin empty state show an empty interior with no card in the slot, and animate the flush as the card dropping out and away.

issues.what: During the compress into SplitCompare, the keyword 'Only the note' and the 'Gone.' ghost stay up and overlap the incoming SSD panel and its header area (f478).
issues.fix: Exit both labels by f470, or clip them to the left panel as it compresses.

method: Decoded half-scale frames only (out/ep06/v1/ep06_film.mp4, 960×540, frame index = absolute frame); no playback, no audio. I read PLAYBOOK §4-§8, DIRECTION (all), the TRANSCRIPT for P01-P07, and editorial §D V1-V4 plus §E C00-C07 and C25. I used 12 images in total, all saved in out/ep06/review/v1/S1-S3/. Overview sheets: s1_overview (0-1408, step 30, 47 frames), s2_overview (1400-3180, step 30, 60 frames), s3_overview (3160-5130, step 35, 57 frames). Dense sync sheets at the transcript word frames: s1_dense (71 frames), s2_dense (69), s3_dense (62), mix_dense (34: SSD cleanup 655-697, Shift+Delete 1928-1956, wall 2160-2280, card swap 3478-3506, read pulse 3700-3760). Full half-scale montages with margin and bottom-140 guides: s1_full (f600, 660, 676, 690, 906, 1100) and s3_full (f4545, 4600, 5103, 5104, 5107, 3545). Text crops at 2× with a 10 px ruler (s1_text, s23_text) gave the cap heights. Bin crops (bins.png) at f0, 45, 76, 90, 100, 120, 1400 and 4035. Numerical checks: tools/static_check.py on an extracted clip of frames 0-5133 found 0 frozen stretches and 0 empty frames; a custom motion profile found no stretch with motion under 1.0 lasting 60 f or more, and only one under 1.5 (f670-767). A frame-difference cut list located every hard cut and flash. Pixel counts on the chip regions timed the chip onsets ('Not yet.' f826, 'Probably…' f888) and the scanner occlusion (f894-906). The S1-S3 render logs contain 0 '[kit]' text warnings. grep found no Math.random or Date in src/ep06. I read the cues.json files for S1-S3 as code only. No full-res stills were rendered, because every doubtful label measured above the floor on the half-scale frames. There was no previous review, so prev_fixed is omitted.
